scope: Synthetic API intercepts only; real native chart and controls. Real iframe DOM drag controls; native line state observed via test-only proxy. No owner, provider or broker writes.
cases: Enabled Scalper preset saves without errors and restores independent legs after reload; disabling both clears the preset
First quick Buy initializes and fills at current quote in one browser request, preserving revisions; double click cannot duplicate, no dialog or implicit protections
Iframe SL/TP hit-target drag survives the pause refresh; valid SELL TP commits once and crossed TP is rejected without a request
Visible TP/SL handles and keyboard deletion work; read-only Buy/Sell Entry uses side color and X opens confirmation; Scalper stop-only Sell uses saved 15 pip distance
Equal-price set TP, unset SL and Entry never overlap for Buy/Sell at1064/1368px, during drag preview or Escape rollback
Delayed mutation keeps preview/native line together; Escape, invalid and rejected ghost reset; Log/Invert/percent/indexed modes and viewport resize retain controls
Scalper target-only percent conversion, restored native position shows actual PnL and entry X sends close against position ID
Legacy order initializes the simulator on submit, then fills the market order at the current quote using the returned revision
Rejected quick entry removes pending preview; light/dark palette switches retain chart controls
409 retains domain rejection detail; only actual revision conflicts show the stale-session lock
